## Affected case

Provide the case number, README language and source link.

## Requested correction or removal

Explain what should change and include a supporting public source if available. Rights holders may request removal of their work.

## Relevant context

Share only information suitable for a public issue. Do not post private contact details, credentials or confidential documents. The maintainer will review the source and synchronize accepted corrections across languages.
